[IALC.1.1] libds defines six function-like macros — `DS_MALLOC(sz)`,
`DS_CALLOC(n,sz)`, `DS_REALLOC(p,sz)`, `DS_FREE(p)`, `DS_STRDUP(s)`,
`DS_STRNDUP(s,n)` — in an internal header `runtime/src/libds/ds_alloc.h`.
Every hand-written libds translation unit that allocates must include
`ds_alloc.h` and must express allocation through these macros and the
public `ds_free` ([IALC.4]); it must not call libc
`malloc`/`calloc`/`realloc`/`free`/`strdup`/`strndup` directly. The sole
exception is `ds_alloc.c` ([IALC.1.3]). Each macro must parenthesise
every argument.
